title: Tissue-normalized joint CBV/MTT compensation at matched flow
kernel_provenance: Operator-authored successor (2026-09-01), not scout-generated. Grounded verbatim in idea-023's ratified interpretation (sha256 775b28c582be..., ratified 2026-08-31, ledger INTERPRETATION_RATIFIED) and the cross-family-approved confer exchange q0002 (CONCUR after one bounded revision). The interpretation's 'Next decision' item 3 explicitly commissions this registration path; confer q0002 SUGGESTED UPDATES item 4 supplies the question sketch adopted below.
revival_basis: Idea-023's preregistered census returned a decisive negative on DIRECTIONAL CONSISTENCY, not on power (all CI widths <= 0.065 vs the 0.15 bound; 99 patients/band) and not on the question: signs were (+, -, +) with two opposite-signed intervals excluding zero. The ratified interpretation binds that negative to the OPERATIONALIZATION and records a specific, label-blind-documented design defect: in cited lowest-flow-band cases the low-CBV quartile cells sit at frankly hypodense NCCT attenuation (e.g. sub-stroke0092 Q1 median 3.0 HU vs Q4 23.0 HU; sub-stroke0057 5.0 vs 24.0; sub-stroke0189 6.0 vs 25.0 -- bin_tissue_audit.csv), so the contrast there partly re-measures visible tissue injury rather than a hemodynamic state at matched tissue. The retired contralateral mirror had been the implicit tissue normalizer; its removal was never compensated. Cohort prevalence of the imbalance was deliberately NOT computed (no governed aggregate exists) -- quantifying it is this successor's first rung.
question: Under a tissue-normalized reference at matched CBF deficit, does the joint CBV/MTT coordinate carry a directionally consistent, precision-bounded final-infarct association across within-patient flow bands in the icobrain cva treated cohort?
deliverable_sentence: Within viable-attenuation tissue at matched relative CBF, the joint CBV/MTT coordinate shows a directionally stable, precision-bounded final-infarct association across all three within-patient flow bands -- establishing, or decisively refusing, the Stage-0 prerequisite that idea-023's untissued operationalization could not test cleanly.
scientific_uncertainty: At the same relative CBF deficit and WITHIN tissue of comparable NCCT viability, does the remaining one-degree-of-freedom joint CBV/MTT coordinate (central-volume identity confirmed to ~0.008 median absolute residual in these maps) relate to final-infarct membership in one consistent direction -- or was the parent's band-2/band-3 sign reversal itself a tissue-composition artifact?
mechanism: Preserved versus reduced blood volume at matched flow remains a named hemodynamic state; the parent run established that in the released maps CBV, CBF and MTT carry one degree of freedom at fixed CBF (identity residual census), so the coordinate is well-defined. What is unresolved is whether its outcome relationship is stable once frankly injured tissue -- which mechanically depresses CBV and is already visible on NCCT -- is removed from the comparison cells.
keystone_prerequisite: Two-rung Stage 0, both label-blind at design time. Rung 0a (uses ONLY the already-imported take-13 bundle; pure CPU): a governed aggregate analysis of bin_tissue_audit.csv (594 rows = 99 cases x 3 bands x 2 cells) quantifying, per band, the cohort prevalence and magnitude of Q1-vs-Q4 attenuation imbalance -- converting the interpretation's cited-cases inference into a measured design input, exactly the gap the interpretation names as successor work. Rung 0b: freeze an NCCT-only tissue-viability gate (HU window specified before any outcome access; frank hypodensity excluded from quartile cells), re-run Phase-S synthetic calibration UNDER the gate to select new support minima and a new CI-width bound (the parent's 0.15 is NOT inherited), then a single tissue-gated census take under a newly approved contract, judged by the same three-band directional conjunction form.
keystone_evidence: Empirical starting points already on the record (evidence FOR the design, not for the claim): per_stratum_summary.csv band CIs -- band 1 mean d +0.0064 [-0.0268,+0.0384]; band 2 -0.0320 [-0.0559,-0.0080]; band 3 +0.0231 [+0.0050,+0.0436]; near-zero patient medians in all bands (heterogeneity); identity_residual_summary.csv medians 0.0078/0.0036/0.0078; bin_tissue_audit.csv per-case HU rows including the cited band-1 hypodense-Q1 examples and the band-3 wide-IQR example (sub-stroke0133 Q4 IQR 314.5).
keystone_residual_assumption: That an NCCT attenuation window separates established injury / partial-volume CSF from viable tissue without proxying the outcome label itself. Residuals: hypodensity timing relative to follow-up labeling; gate-induced support loss concentrating in the lowest-flow band (Phase-S must size it and may refuse the design); no contralateral reference exists to cross-check the gate (the mirror stays retired); residual hyperdense vessel contamination surviving the per-patient p98 CBV cap.
X_measurement: As the parent's mirror-free design, with one addition: per-cell NCCT HU gating using the audit machinery that already ran label-blind in take 13. For each patient: eroded Tmax>6s deficit region; three within-patient CBF-percentile bands over finite deficit CBF; per-patient log-CBV quartile cells; Q1-vs-Q4 final-infarct membership contrast d with equal patient weights and patient-bootstrap CIs -- computed only over voxels passing the frozen viability window, with per-cell surviving-voxel counts recorded and gated by the Phase-S-selected minima.
standing_confounds_addressed: Frank-hypodensity tissue composition (the parent's documented failure input) -- addressed by construction via the frozen gate, with Rung 0a measuring how much of the cohort it actually affects. Vessel/hyperdense contamination -- p98 cap retained; the audit's wide-IQR example motivates Phase-S review of whether the cap needs an audit-informed companion bound. Between-patient heterogeneity (means vs near-zero medians) -- named; the gate stays mean-based as preregistered, and the census will additionally REPORT (non-gating) the median-based descriptor so the divergence is visible rather than adjudicated post hoc.
use_vs_association: Association only. Model-use remains a separately contracted question, contingent on this Stage 0, exactly as the parent structured it.
rung: Rung 0a: aggregate tissue-audit analysis on the existing bundle (cheap, CPU, no new data access). Rung 0b: gate freeze + Phase-S recalibration + single tissue-gated census (this idea's decisive experiment). Rung 1+: model-use probes, conditional on 0b passing, each under its own approved contract.
smallest_decisive_experiment: The Rung-0b tissue-gated census: one frozen analysis, one take, on the released 100-case census split only; the 49 reserved cases remain untouched; same conjunction form, new Phase-S-derived bounds.

anticipated_negative.meaning: If the tissue-gated census fails the same directional/precision conjunction with adequate post-gate support, then the matched-flow joint-state formulation lacks the Stage-0 prerequisite even after removing the parent's documented tissue confound. With the parent already negative, that would strongly indicate the mirror-free compensation framing is not census-viable in this cohort, and the lineage PAUSEs terminally absent NEW empirical confound evidence -- taste is not grounds for a third operationalization. It would still not be evidence that CBV/MTT lacks biological importance, and says nothing about models.

prohibited_conclusions: Do not call the measured state autoregulatory blood-volume reserve or any physiological mechanism without independent evidence.
Do not draw any model-use or feature-selection conclusion; no model is probed at this rung (confer q0002 review, claim-bounds finding).
Do not claim cohort-wide tissue-imbalance prevalence before the Rung-0a aggregate analysis exists.
Do not attribute CBV-versus-MTT channel structure; the identity degeneracy is confirmed.
dies_like_prior: Inherits idea-009/016 IDENTIFIABILITY risk at the eventual model rung. New named risk specific to this design: tissue-gate circularity -- an HU window near infarct-typical attenuation could partially encode the outcome; mitigated by freezing the window from NCCT physics alone before any label access, auditing surviving support label-blind, and the fact that the gate REMOVES the suspect voxels rather than weighting by them. The parent's own failure mode (mixed tissue in comparison cells) is the one this design exists to eliminate.
closest_prior_work: Robben et al. (native CTP final-infarct prediction with treatment variables) for the eventual model rung; contralateral-mirror normalization as standard perfusion practice -- the retired arm this design replaces with an explicit, auditable tissue gate; the parent take-13 census itself, whose artifacts are this card's evidence base.
existing_legwork: Complete and imported: take-13 bundle at probes/023/results/results_v2 (import commit 1c0acdbf5dcc...), including bin_tissue_audit.csv (594 rows), per_stratum_summary.csv, identity_residual_summary.csv, exclusions.csv; split manifest sha256 da79e94b... frozen before label access; Phase-S apparatus and its selected-operating-point machinery (contract-amendment path) proven across the parent's six-blob lineage; dataset pin Zenodo 16813698, train.7z md5 36ae28b9a17f7340b8bbef62b595cb57.
verified_facts: 149 released cases; 100-case census split frozen (sha256 da79e94b...) before any label access; 49 reserved cases untouched (summary.json).
Band CIs and widths as recorded in per_stratum_summary.csv; all widths <= 0.0652 against the frozen 0.15.
Central-volume identity median absolute residual <= 0.0078 in all bands (identity_residual_summary.csv).
594 label-blind per-case/band/cell HU audit rows exist in the imported bundle; no aggregate statistic was computed (interpretation, Suggests item 3).
Two preregistered exclusions executed exactly (sub-stroke0043 source-corrupt; sub-stroke0142 duplicate lesion member).
unverified_claims: Cohort-wide prevalence and magnitude of Q1-vs-Q4 attenuation imbalance (Rung 0a's deliverable).
Adequacy of post-gate voxel/patient support in the lowest-flow band (Phase-S question).
Directional stability of the tissue-gated association (the keystone itself).
confirmatory_separation: The confirmatory question at this rung is presence of a directionally stable, precision-bounded ASSOCIATION under tissue control -- not use, not mechanism, not reserve-vs-generic physiology.

claim_identifiability.positive: A passed conjunction under the frozen tissue gate identifies a stable outcome association of the joint coordinate at matched flow within viable tissue, in this cohort and pipeline -- sufficient to authorize a model-use contract.
claim_identifiability.negative: A failed conjunction with adequate post-gate support identifies the absence of that stable association under the best tissue-controlled mirror-free operationalization available -- terminal for the lineage absent new empirical confound evidence.

data_and_compute: Public ISLES'24 training release only, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, no DUA; identical Zenodo pin as the parent. Rung 0a is minutes of CPU on an already-imported 594-row CSV. Rung 0b mirrors the parent's compute envelope (Phase-S synthetic on CPU/modest GPU; census on Colab with per-case checkpoints).

clarity.why: One gated question, one added mechanism (a frozen NCCT viability window) atop an already-executed design; operator-assigned pending critique.

identifiability.why: Association-level claim is identifiable by the same conjunction; the new gate adds one auditable assumption (window validity) that Rung 0a partially measures.

medical_relevance.why: Whether perfusion-derived compensation state carries outcome information in treated cohorts bears on triage-model inputs; unchanged from parent.

interest.why: The parent's opposite-signed bands plus documented tissue mixing make the tissue-controlled answer genuinely diagnostic either way.

prior_legwork.why: The entire evidence base, audit instrumentation, split, pins, and Phase-S apparatus already exist from the parent.

feasibility.why: Rung 0a is trivial; Rung 0b reuses proven machinery with one added filter; main risk is post-gate support, which Phase-S is designed to size.

data_readiness.why: Dataset pinned, staged path proven, census split frozen and reserved set intact.

evaluation_readiness.why: Estimator, bootstrap, and gate form are inherited verbatim; only the voxel-admission rule and recalibrated bounds are new.

negative_result_value.why: A tissue-controlled negative terminates the lineage decisively -- the highest-value negative available to this question.

novelty_confidence.why: Tissue-aware normalization is standard practice; the novelty is the governed, preregistered census framing, not the gate concept.

regret.why: Low: bounded compute, no new data exposure, reserve untouched.

mechanism_clarity.why: The confound being removed is empirically documented in the parent's own label-blind audit rows.
